$comment: OPTIONAL legacy-import format. Leagues are normally added from the in-app Settings screen. If this file (or the LEAGUES_JSON env var) is present on a FRESH database, it is imported once — adminCode becomes the commissioner password (needs >= 6 chars), each accessCode is kept. After that the DB is authoritative and this file is ignored.

managerAliases.$comment: map a stale Sleeper user_id to the canonical one it should merge into, e.g. "0000000000": "1111111111"

displayNameOverrides.$comment: map a Sleeper user_id to the name to show instead of their display_name
